ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels comprise approximately 95% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized to less than 5% of the surface area at the distal tips and peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary solid dark pigmentation across the entire fluke; distinct high-contrast white geometric clusters at the terminal distal tips (coordinates: top-left and top-right extremes); vertical white linear streaks at the bottom-center peduncle interface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped median notch with an estimated interior angle of 50-55 degrees; vertical depth is approximately 15% of the total visible height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration; the left lobe trailing edge features three high-amplitude peaks (20-30 pixels) and deep troughs; the right lobe features lower-amplitude, higher-frequency saw-tooth serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from the median notch extending to pointed distal tips; asymmetrical sweep with a deeper secondary concave indentation on the outer-left trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense white high-contrast clusters located at both the left and right fluke tips; scattered punctate white spots visible across the medial and lateral surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three to four distinct vertical, parallel white linear marks (rake-like) localized at the base of the fluke near the center peduncle connection.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring or barnacle colonization at the extreme distal points of both lobes; a deep, atypical indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe approximately one-third inward from the tip.
